SELECT FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS WHERE TOURISM_NAME = #{tourismName} ORDER BY RECORD_TIME DESC

SELECT ROUND(AVG(DENSITY), 2) as avgDensity, MAX(DENSITY) as maxDensity, MIN(DENSITY) as minDensity, ROUND(AVG(COUNT), 2) as avgCount, MAX(COUNT) as maxCount, MIN(COUNT) as minCount FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS WHERE DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode} AND RECORD_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT TOURISM_NAME, COUNT(CASE WHEN DENSITY < 0.3 THEN 1 END) as lowDensity, COUNT(CASE WHEN DENSITY >= 0.3 AND DENSITY < 0.7 THEN 1 END) as mediumDensity, COUNT(CASE WHEN DENSITY >= 0.7 THEN 1 END) as highDensity FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS WHERE RECORD_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY TOURISM_NAME

SELECT DEVICE_CODE as deviceCode, DEVICE_NAME as deviceName, COUNT(*) as occurrences, ROUND(AVG(DENSITY), 2) as avgDensity, MAX(DENSITY) as maxDensity, MIN(DENSITY) as minDensity FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS WHERE (#{tourismName} IS NULL OR TOURISM_NAME = #{tourismName}) AND (#{deviceCode} IS NULL OR DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode}) AND DENSITY >= #{densityThreshold} AND RECORD_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DEVICE_CODE, DEVICE_NAME ORDER BY occurrences DESC

SELECT AVG(density) as avg_density, MAX(density) as max_density, COUNT(*) as total_records, SUM(CASE WHEN density >= 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as high_density_count FROM CROWD_STATISTICS WHERE tourism_name = #{tourismName} AND record_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
